title: See your selection
new: Credits (and power, if your side uses it) sit on the top edge; while you place a building, the card under them shows the values after it.
Select something and a panel at the bottom left shows it: one unit, a group by kind, a building, a building going up, a supply pile or an enemy.
A refused order shows the game's reason on a line at the bottom centre (still in the game's own words; plainer words come next).

The bottom-right buttons follow your selection: build buttons for one builder, Attack move and Stop for armed units, Unload for a loaded vehicle or Tunnel Hub. Keys are on the buttons; Unload moved from U to F.
Right-click acts on what is under the pointer: move, attack, collect from a pile, or enter a Scout Car or Tunnel Hub. Esc or a right-click cancels a placement or an attack move.

title: Notes that never block
new: The playtest notes live in one panel: checklist, questions and markers, any time during or after a match. The key left of 1 (shown in the panel title) opens it.
The panel never pauses or blocks play and has no Save button: notes save themselves. Only the marker box (N) pauses an offline match while it is open.
On desktop your notes are filed when you quit or close the window; in the browser they download when you come back to the launcher.

try.text: Type a comment into one of the panel's fields mid-match, then click the battlefield and give an order
Press N, pick a kind and Save, finish the match, then type a comment under the marker

Answer the questions first. Desktop: type in a field, leave the cursor in it, close the window, restart and look in the Notes folder shown on this card. Browser: go back to the main menu and look in your downloads.

title: Result panel
new: After a match the panel shows the match length and, for every player, units built, units lost and buildings lost.
If your opponent leaves mid-match you win, and the panel says so.
Leaving an online match now says what it means.

title: Play again
new: After a match, Play again starts a new one with the same friend and the same link.
A waiting match stays open for 15 minutes, with a countdown.
Enter joins a code; Cancel or Esc stops connecting.
